from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687689/attempts/a19917c2b2c442ba9dde2ee9fd880e7d/system/state/workspace/programs/task-97512d09.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # The divider row separates two same-sized masks. Combine their occupied cells.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 4 for v in row))
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[3 if upper[r][c] != 0 or lower[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(upper[r]))]
            for r in range(len(upper))]
'''
p.write_text(source)
# Validate against demo then produce test output
ns={}
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)

demo_out=[[3,3,3,3,0],[3,3,3,3,3],[0,0,3,3,3],[3,3,3,3,0]]
print(ns['transform'](demo_in)==demo_out)
